name: UMLS to SNOMED/ICD-10-CM Mapper
what_it_is: A Python script that reads UMLS Metathesaurus files and generates JSON mappings from UMLS CUIs to SNOMED CT or ICD-10-CM codes using three traversal strategies.
constraints: Requires NLM UMLS license and manual file download
Config is hard-coded in source; no CLI flags
RO/PAR_CHD need MRREL.RRF in addition to MRCONSO
